title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
title_zh: PyRUA-DataFarm：以大语言模型智能体作为低成本高效的真实可用机器人数据远程操作员

paragraphs.en: Teleoperation remains the default way to collect robot demonstrations, but every episode costs robot and operator time, and every new task starts from scratch. We ask whether a coding agent can take over the teleoperator’s job. In our DataFarm , the agent receives a data request and one calibration episode of the robot in the target scene and rebuilds the task in simulation: it writes the scene, an expert controller, and a success judge. The simulator supplies exact actions, and a video model conditioned on real images renders each rollout as photographic video, generating all camera views together consistently. The output is real-ready data: synchronized camera views labelled with the robot’s actions, on which a policy can be trained directly and deployed on the real robot. Independent judges certify the expert and every rendered episode before admission. On five real-robot tasks, policies trained only on farm data match policies trained on as many teleoperated episodes (93 vs. 84 successes in 100 trials), and under an unseen tablecloth and coloured light they keep 87 successes where the teleoperation-trained policies fall to 46. Adapting a task is fully automatic and costs $21 of API usage on average, paid once per task, plus $5 for a render contract; every further episode costs $0.80 on average for simulation, rendering, and review, with no robot or operator. One hour of three-view data for a task costs $107 on average, these costs included, slightly below a quote of $117 for teleoperation in China and below $290 in labour alone in North America.
paragraphs.zh: 遥操作仍然是收集机器人示范数据的默认方式，但每一段演示都要消耗机器人和操作员的时间，而且每个新任务都要从零开始。 我们探究一个编码智能体能否接管遥操作员的工作。 在我们的 DataFarm 中，智能体接收一条数据请求以及机器人在目标场景中的一段校准演示，然后在仿真中重建该任务：它会编写场景、一个专家控制器和一个成功判定器。 仿真器提供精确的动作，而一个以真实图像为条件的视频模型将每次 rollout 渲染成照片级视频，并一致地同时生成所有相机视角。 输出是可直接用于真实机器人（real-ready）的数据：带有机器人动作标注的同步相机视角，策略可以在其上直接训练并部署到真实机器人上。 独立的判定器会在数据被采纳之前对专家和每一段渲染出的演示进行认证。 在五个真实机器人任务上，仅用农场数据训练的策略与用同样数量遥操作演示训练的策略表现相当（100 次试验中 93 次对 84 次成功），而在未见过的桌布和彩色光照下，它们保持 87 次成功，而遥操作数据训练的策略则跌至 46 次。 适配一个任务完全自动进行，平均花费 21 美元的 API 用量，每个任务只需支付一次，外加 5 美元的渲染合约；之后每生成一段演示平均花费 0.80 美元，涵盖仿真、渲染和审核，全程无需机器人或操作员。 在计入上述费用的情况下，一个任务一小时的三个视角数据平均花费 107 美元，略低于中国遥操作 117 美元的报价，也低于北美仅人工就需 290 美元的成本。

paragraphs.en: Teleoperation remains the primary source of training data for robot policies [ 25 , 2 , 3 ] . Its appeal is that the data are faithful by construction: every recorded action was executed by the robot, and every image shows the scene in which the policy will be deployed. Its weakness is cost. Each episode requires a robot, an operator, and resets after failures, so the cost grows with the amount of data and starts over with every new task, scene, or viewpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 遥操作仍然是机器人策略训练数据的主要来源 [ 25 , 2 , 3 ] 。 它的吸引力在于数据天然保真：每条记录的动作都由机器人实际执行，每张图像展示的正是策略将要部署的场景。它的弱点是成本。 每次采集（episode）都需要一台机器人、一名操作员，并在失败后进行复位，因此成本随数据量增长而上升，且每换一个新任务、新场景或新视角都要从零开始。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic data promises to break this scaling, yet existing pipelines trade the cost of collection for two other costs. The first is human engineering: whether demonstrations are multiplied from a few seeds [ 34 , 49 ] or tasks are written by language models [ 46 , 6 ] , a person still has to assemble and debug the scene, the expert, and the success check for every new task. The second is the visual gap between simulation and reality. Real-to-sim-to-real methods narrow it by reconstructing the scene [ 44 , 16 , 37 ] , but whatever is hard to reconstruct, such as deformable cloth or a lit display, still looks synthetic, while video generation models that synthesize the motion themselves can no longer provide exact action labels [ 22 ] . Producing real-ready robot data, exact enough to train on and realistic enough to deploy on the real robot without any real demonstrations, cheaply for every new task therefore remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 合成数据有望打破这一扩展瓶颈，但现有的流水线只是把采集的成本换成了另外两种成本。 第一种是人工工程成本：无论是从少量种子演示中扩增演示 [ 34 , 49 ]，还是由语言模型编写任务 [ 46 , 6 ]，每个新任务的场景、专家策略和成功判据仍需要人工来搭建和调试。 第二种是仿真与真实之间的视觉差距。 实-仿-实方法通过重建场景来缩小这一差距 [ 44 , 16 , 37 ]，但凡是难以重建的东西，例如可变形的布料或点亮的显示屏，看起来仍然很假；而那些自行合成运动画面的视频生成模型，则无法再提供精确的动作标签 [ 22 ]。 因此，如何为每个新任务低成本地生产可直接用于真实环境且足够的机器人数据——精确到足以用于训练、真实到无需任何真实演示即可部署到真实机器人上——仍然是一个未解难题。

paragraphs.en: We address this problem with DataFarm , an agentic data farm in which a coding agent takes over the teleoperator’s role, a simulator supplies the actions, and a video model supplies the appearance (Figure 2 ). Given a data request and a single calibration episode, a short recording of the robot in the target scene, the agent compiles the task into simulation as an engineer would: it reconstructs the scene and cameras from the calibration episode, verifies that the simulator can reproduce the required skills, and writes an expert controller together with a success judge. The simulator then executes the expert from many initial states to produce trajectories with exact actions and states, and a video model conditioned on real frames renders each trajectory, all camera views in one generation, in the appearance of the target scene, where new appearances such as a different tablecloth or lighting are specified in text. The output is real-ready: synchronized, mutually consistent photographic camera views with the robot’s own action labels, which a policy consumes exactly as it would consume teleoperated data. Because the agent harness is decoupled from individual tasks, a new task requires no task-specific engineering by a person, and once a task is compiled, every further episode is produced without a robot, an operator, or a reset.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用 DataFarm 来解决这个问题：这是一个智能体化的数据农场，其中编码智能体接管遥操作员的职责，仿真器提供动作，视频模型提供外观（图 2）。 给定一个数据请求和一段标定片段（即机器人在目标场景中的简短录制），智能体会像工程师一样将任务编译到仿真中：它根据标定片段重建场景和相机，验证仿真器能够复现所需技能，并编写一个专家控制器和一个成功判定器。 随后仿真器从多个初始状态执行专家策略，生成带有精确动作和状态的轨迹，而以真实帧为条件的视频模型在一次生成中渲染每个轨迹的所有相机视角，使其呈现目标场景的外观，其中诸如不同桌布或光照等新外观可通过文本指定。 输出是可直接用于真实场景的：同步且相互一致的逼真相机视角画面，附带机器人自身的动作标签，策略可以像消费遥操作数据一样直接使用它们。 由于智能体框架与单个任务解耦，新任务无需人工进行任务专属的工程工作，而且一旦任务编译完成，之后的每一段数据都无需机器人、操作员或重置即可生成。

paragraphs.en: Delegating data production to an agent, however, raises a question that teleoperation never faces: who verifies the data? An agent that writes both the expert and its success checks may approve its own mistakes, and a video model asked to look realistic may copy the layout of its references, hallucinate objects, or drift from the simulated motion. DataFarm therefore separates certification from production. The expert is developed against a judge it cannot inspect and admitted only on held-out initial states, the renderer may alter appearance but not geometry, objects, or timing, and every rendered episode is compared with its simulated state by machine checks and an independent reviewer before it enters the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将数据生产委托给智能体会带来一个遥操作从未面对过的问题：谁来验证数据？ 一个同时撰写专家策略及其成功检验的智能体可能会认可自己的错误，而一个被要求生成逼真画面的视频模型可能会照搬其参考素材的布局、幻觉出物体，或偏离模拟的运动。 因此，DataFarm 将认证与生产分离开来。 专家策略针对一个它无法查看的裁判进行开发，并且只有在保留的初始状态上通过后才被采纳；渲染器可以改变外观，但不能改变几何结构、物体或时序；并且每个渲染出的片段在进入数据集之前，都要通过机器检查和独立审核者与其模拟状态进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on five bimanual tasks covering rigid, articulated, deformable, and display-bearing objects show that this design yields real-ready data at low cost: policies are trained on it directly and deployed on the real robot (Figure 1 ). Policies trained only on farm data match those trained on the same number of teleoperated episodes in the original scene (93 vs. 84 successes in 100 trials) and remain robust under a tablecloth and coloured light absent from both training sets (87 vs. 46), which we attribute to the appearance variation the farm adds around fixed, exact trajectories. Rendering with real images is essential to this transfer: the same trajectories rendered with conventional domain randomization yield only 26 and 21 successes (Section 6.1 ). Every camera view of a farm episode both follows the simulation and looks real: image statistics place farm episodes more than twice as close to real camera frames as the simulator’s own renderings, and the farm’s renderer keeps all views faithful to the simulated motion, whereas calling the video model directly does not (Section 6.4 ). The farm also operates without human intervention: adapting a task costs $21 of API usage on average, paid once per task, a render contract adds $5, and every further episode costs $0.80 on average for simulation, rendering, re-rendering, and review, in the original scene or under new appearance, so 100 episodes of a task cost $1.06 per episode on average, and one hour of synchronized three-view data for a task costs $107, these costs included, slightly below a quote of $117 for teleoperation in China and below $290 in labour alone in North America (Section 6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总之，我们的贡献有三点：

paragraphs.en: We introduce DataFarm , an agentic data farm that turns a data request and one calibration episode into verified, real-ready robot data without human intervention. The simulator determines actions and states, a real-image-conditioned video model determines appearance, and certification is kept separate from production, all under an agent harness that is independent of individual tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 DataFarm，一个智能体化的数据工厂，它能在无需人工干预的情况下，将数据请求和一次校准环节转化为经过验证、可直接投入实际使用的机器人数据。 仿真器决定动作与状态，以真实图像为条件的视频模型决定外观，认证环节与数据生产相互分离，这一切都在一个独立于具体任务的智能体框架之下运行。

sents.en: We introduce DataFarm , an agentic data farm that turns a data request and one calibration episode into verified, real-ready robot data without human intervention.
sents.zh: 我们介绍 DataFarm，一个智能体化的数据工厂，它能在无需人工干预的情况下，将数据请求和一次校准环节转化为经过验证、可直接投入实际使用的机器人数据。

paragraphs.en: We show that the farm produces action-labelled, multi-view data that closely matches real camera recordings, at a lower cost than teleoperation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，该数据农场能够生成带有动作标签的多视角数据，与真实相机录制的画面高度匹配，且成本低于遥操作。

paragraphs.en: We show on a real robot that policies trained solely on farm data match teleoperated data in the original scene, generalize substantially better to unseen appearance, and far outperform a conventional real-to-sim-to-real baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实机器人上展示，仅使用农场数据训练的策略在原始场景中可与遥操作数据相媲美，对未见过的外观具有显著更强的泛化能力，并远超传统的真实-仿真-真实基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Large teleoperated datasets drive recent vision-language-action models [ 25 , 2 , 3 ] , and hand-held interfaces and fleet orchestrators lower the cost of each episode [ 9 , 1 ] , but every episode still needs a person, a device, and a physical scene. Demonstration generators multiply a few demonstrations into many, in simulation [ 34 , 14 , 24 ] or in point-cloud space [ 49 ] , assuming a simulation task that people have built or point-cloud observations. DataFarm needs one calibration episode, reuses none of its actions, and outputs photographic multi-view video.

paragraphs.en: Language models write policies as code [ 28 ] , rewards [ 33 ] , and simulation tasks with their supervision [ 46 , 47 , 6 ] ; coding agents resolve real repository issues [ 50 ] and improve their own programs [ 55 , 19 , 56 ] . These tasks are specified by text and asset libraries rather than by a real scene, and the model that writes a task often also writes its check, although language models are unreliable judges of their own output [ 20 ] . DataFarm grounds the task in a recording of the real scene, has the agent write the expert against a judge it cannot see, and leaves admission to independent reviewers.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型以代码的形式编写策略[28]、奖励[33]以及带有监督的仿真任务[46、47、6]；编码智能体能够解决真实代码库中的问题[50]，并改进自身的程序[55、19、56]。 这些任务由文本和资产库来定义，而非真实的场景，并且编写任务的模型往往也编写其检查器，尽管语言模型对自身输出的判断并不可靠[20]。 DataFarm 将任务建立在真实场景的录制之上，让智能体针对一个它无法看到的裁判来编写专家程序，并将准入判定留给独立的评审者。

Video models generate robot videos with inferred actions [ 22 ] , generate video under structural control [ 35 , 31 ] , or turn simulator renderings into realistic video [ 45 , 4 ] , but structure, physics, and task adherence can fail independently in such videos [ 11 ] . paragraphs.en: The farm compiles each task through a fixed sequence of intermediate representations, much as a compiler lowers a program:

paragraphs.en: The grounding G G describes the scene, the task contract T T and the expert C C define how the task is solved, the episode E E records one execution under a sampled variation z z , the observation O O is its rendering by a video model p p , and the admission record q q certifies the delivered episode d d (Figure 3 ). Each representation is produced by one stage and accepted only after a component other than its producer has checked it, because language models are unreliable judges of their own output [ 20 ] . A rejection is sent back to the earliest stage responsible for the defect, and every failed attempt is kept, so the final dataset comes with a complete record of how it was obtained. The stages are carried out by coding agents [ 50 ] in separate roles [ 18 ] that share one harness of skills, instructions, templates, and verifiers. Because this harness is independent of any particular task, the same farm adapts to a new task without changes to the harness; Appendix A describes it in detail.

paragraphs.en: Grounding turns the calibration episode into a description of the scene that the simulator can reproduce. From the full episode, the agent identifies the robot and the objects, estimates their geometry and articulation [ 8 , 10 ] , and fits the cameras and the metric scale, cross-checking the scale against robot dimensions, known objects, or multiple views. Physical quantities that a short video cannot determine, such as mass or friction, are not guessed: every quantity is labelled as measured, fitted, assumed, or unknown, and uncertain ones are covered by randomization in the simulator [ 43 , 36 ] rather than fixed to a confident but unsupported value. The agent also selects frames of the calibration episode for every camera as appearance references for rendering, so the user never has to supply images that the episode already contains.
paragraphs.zh: 场景接地将标定片段转化为模拟器可以复现的场景描述。 智能体从完整片段中识别出机器人和物体，估计它们的几何结构与关节连接 [ 8 , 10 ]，并拟合相机与度量尺度，同时将尺度与机器人尺寸、已知物体或多视角进行交叉验证。 短视频无法确定的物理量，如质量或摩擦系数，不会被猜测：每个物理量都被标注为已测量、已拟合、已假定或未知，不确定的量由模拟器中的随机化 [ 43 , 36 ] 来覆盖，而不是被固定为一个看似确定却缺乏依据的数值。 智能体还会为每个相机从标定片段中选取若干帧作为渲染的外观参考，因此用户无需再提供片段中已经包含的图像。

paragraphs.en: Before the agent writes an expert, it checks that the simulator can reproduce the skills the task requires, since no expert can succeed in a simulator that cannot, and the failures of such a simulator would otherwise be attributed to the expert. The farm therefore runs short probes of these skills over candidate simulator variants that adjust material, contact, or actuator parameters, and selects the variant with the fewest changes that passes every probe. The selection is issued as a certificate that binds the variant’s files and the result of every probe, the qualification script re-checks the certificate against these results, and all episodes of the task are produced on this certified simulator. Our implementation provides such probes for cloth; other skills need probes of their own.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体编写专家之前，它会检查模拟器能否再现任务所需的技能，因为没有专家能在无法做到这一点的模拟器中取得成功，否则这种模拟器的失败会被归咎于专家。 因此，农场会在调整材质、接触或执行器参数的候选模拟器变体上对这些技能运行简短的探测，并选择通过所有探测的改动最少的变体。 该选择以证书的形式发布，证书绑定该变体的文件和每项探测的结果，资格审查脚本会根据这些结果重新校验证书，而该任务的所有回合都在这个经过认证的模拟器上产生。 我们的实现为布料提供了此类探测；其他技能需要各自的探测。

paragraphs.en: The agent then specifies the task and writes an expert that solves it. Earlier systems let a language model write the task together with its success check or reward [ 46 , 47 , 33 ] ; the farm instead prevents the expert from fitting its own checks, a form of reward hacking [ 41 ] . The task contract T T lists the stages of the task, the conditions that mark their completion, and the shortcuts that are forbidden, such as teleporting objects or relaxing the success criterion. A separate role turns the contract into a judge, which is frozen before the expert is written.

paragraphs.en: Rendering turns each simulated episode into photographic video while leaving its actions, objects, and timing unchanged. paragraphs.en: Our default renderer is MiniMax-H3 in its reference-to-video mode, with the accelerated Sol-H3 [ 27 ] deployment. Four designs, none specific to a task, make its output follow the simulator and keep the cameras consistent (Section 6.4 ); the agent instantiates them for each task from the calibration episode. Structure from the simulator, appearance from the real cameras. As in structure-conditioned video transfer [ 35 , 31 ] , edge maps of the simulator video drive a ControlNet [ 59 ] that fixes the arm pose, the object positions, and the timing, while real frames and a picture of the real robot supply the appearance. All cameras in one generation. The head and wrist views are tiled on one canvas and generated as a single video, so they share lighting and materials and agree on which objects exist and what each gripper holds. References and prompts that add no content. Reference frames match the simulated task state, and each text prompt describes only its own segment, so the model neither re-inserts content from its references nor draws later events too early. Long episodes without drift. Long episodes are generated as independent chunks and joined where neighbouring chunks differ least, which avoids the drift of extending each chunk from the previous output. A vision-language model, run by the agent, compares the renders of each chunk with the simulator video. Our recipe renders several seeds per chunk and keeps the one it selects; the runs costed in Appendix D instead rendered each chunk once and rendered again only the chunks it flagged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的默认渲染器是处于参考到视频模式的 MiniMax-H3，并采用加速部署的 Sol-H3 [27]。 四项设计均不针对特定任务，它们使输出跟随仿真器并保持相机一致（第 6.4 节）；智能体在校准情节中为每个任务实例化这些设计。 结构来自仿真器，外观来自真实相机。 与结构条件视频迁移 [35, 31] 类似，仿真器视频的边缘图驱动一个 ControlNet [59]，以固定机械臂姿态、物体位置和时序，而真实帧和真实机器人的图片则提供外观。 所有相机在一次生成中完成。 头部视角和腕部视角被平铺在同一画布上并作为单个视频生成，因此它们共享光照和材质，并对存在哪些物体以及每个夹爪持有什么达成一致。 不添加任何内容的参考帧与提示词。 参考帧与仿真的任务状态一致，且每条文本提示只描述其自己的片段，因此模型既不会从其参考中重新插入内容，也不会过早绘制后续事件。 无漂移的长情节。 长情节被生成为相互独立的分块，并在相邻分块差异最小处拼接，这避免了通过从前一个输出延展每个分块而产生的漂移。 由智能体运行的一个视觉-语言模型将每个分块的渲染与仿真器视频进行比较。 我们的方案为每个分块渲染多个种子并保留其选中的那一个；而附录 D 中计费的运行方式则是对每个分块只渲染一次，仅对其标记的分块进行重渲染。

paragraphs.en: An episode enters the dataset only if an independent reviewer accepts it after automatic checks. The verifier is a single program shared by all tasks and configured by a task-specific specification that the agent writes. It checks that the rendered video contains the right objects and no extra ones, that events happen when the simulation says they do, that the video is temporally stable and continuous across chunks, that the background is static, that the appearance matches the real scene, and that no layout has been copied from a reference frame. Before a specification is used, it is calibrated, in the manner of mutation testing [ 23 ] , on deliberately corrupted versions of an accepted episode, with objects deleted, duplicated, or enlarged, events shifted in time, views swapped, or colours changed, and every corruption must be caught by the check responsible for it. Every task has its own verifier specification; the default H3 route also relies on a frozen render evaluation and the seed selection of Section 4.5 .

paragraphs.en: Automatic checks are necessary but not sufficient, because a generated video can look plausible frame by frame and still contradict its labels [ 11 ] . Every episode is therefore also examined by an independent reviewer [ 61 , 60 ] , a separate agent that compares the decoded video with the real reference frames and the simulated state and records its evidence for each verdict. A final delivery check confirms that the dataset is complete, unmodified, backed by the full record of attempts, and reviewed episode by episode; the automatic checks gate the render stage rather than delivery. Policy training starts only from a dataset whose admission record has been verified.
paragraphs.zh: 自动检查是必要的但并不充分，因为生成的视频可能逐帧看起来都合理，却仍然与其标签相矛盾 [11]。 因此，每个回合还会由一名独立审查者 [61, 60] 进行检查，这是一个单独的智能体，它将解码后的视频与真实参考帧以及模拟状态进行比较，并为每个判定记录其依据。 最终的交付检查确认数据集是完整的、未被修改的、有完整的尝试记录作为支撑，并且已经过逐回合审查；自动检查把守的是渲染阶段而非交付阶段。 策略训练只能从准入记录已通过验证的数据集开始。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DataFarm on five bimanual manipulation tasks on a dual-arm PiPER robot, chosen so that each stresses a different part of the farm (Table 2 ): nesting three rigid cups, placing an apple on a digital scale whose display changes with the load, beating a drum in rhythm, putting a block into a drawer and closing it, and folding a towel. For each task, the farm receives one calibration episode recorded with a head camera and two wrist cameras together with a request for 100 episodes, and the agent produces every task artifact from these inputs. Rigid and articulated objects are simulated in SAPIEN through RoboTwin 2.0 [ 6 ] and the towel in Isaac Sim with particle cloth. Unless stated otherwise, observations are rendered with our self-hosted MiniMax-H3 deployment, and Seedance serves as a second renderer (Sections 6.4 and 6.5 ).

paragraphs.en: For every task, we post-train π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 3 ] on three training sets of equal size N = 100 N=100 that share the observation and action spaces, the camera views, and the training recipe (50-step action horizon, batch size 128, 50k steps), so that the sets differ only in where their episodes come from. Real teleop uses N N teleoperated episodes of the task in the original scene. paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们在三个大小均为 N = 100 的训练集上对 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [3] 进行后训练，这三个训练集共享观测空间与动作空间、相机视角以及训练方案（50 步动作时域、批大小 128、5 万步），因此它们的区别仅在于回合数据的来源。 Real teleop（真实遥操作）使用原始场景中该任务的 N 条遥操作回合。 Sim + DR（仿真加域随机化）是一种传统的 real-to-sim-to-real 基线，它直接在仿真器中渲染与我们相同的仿真轨迹，并采用 RoboTwin 2.0 风格的纹理、光照与干扰物域随机化 [6]；由于它与 DataFarm 共享同样的接地场景、专家策略和动作，因此可以隔离出观测生成方式带来的影响。 最后，DataFarm 只使用农场的渲染回合，不使用任何真实数据。 它在每个任务的训练集中，将原始场景的渲染与通过渲染契约以文本方式改变桌面材质和光照的渲染混合在一起，例如更暖或更冷光照下的木质或石质桌面；用于 OOD 评估的桌布不出现在任何训练集中。

paragraphs.en: We organize the results around five questions. Do policies trained only on farm data work on the real robot, and how do they compare with teleoperated data and with a conventional real-to-sim-to-real pipeline (Section 6.1 )? What does the farm cost (Section 6.2 )? Do its episodes keep the simulated motion that the action labels describe (Section 6.3 ), and do all three camera views both follow the simulation and look like real recordings, which a direct call to the video model does not achieve (Section 6.4 )? And what does video rendering add for objects that a simulator models poorly (Section 6.5 )?
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕五个问题组织实验结果。 仅在农场数据上训练的策略能否在真实机器人上工作，它们与遥操作数据以及传统真-仿真-真流水线（第 6.1 节）相比表现如何？ 农场的成本是多少（第 6.2 节）？ 农场生成的回合是否保留了动作标签所描述的仿真运动（第 6.3 节），并且三个相机视角是否都既遵循仿真又看起来像真实录制的画面——这是直接调用视频模型所无法实现的（第 6.4 节）？ 对于仿真器建模不佳的物体，视频渲染又能带来什么（第 6.5 节）？

paragraphs.en: Policies trained only on farm data perform on par with teleoperated data in the original scene and substantially better under unseen appearance (Figure 4 a). In the original scene, they reach 93 successes in 100 trials against 84 for teleoperated data, matching or exceeding them on four of the five tasks and falling one success behind on stack cups. Under OOD conditions, the teleoperation-trained policies drop to 46 successes, whereas the farm-trained policies keep 87 and lead on every task. Figure 4 (b) shows typical OOD trials.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在农场数据上训练的策略在原始场景中与遥操作数据训练的策略表现相当，而在未见过的外观条件下则显著更优（图 4 a）。 在原始场景中，它们在 100 次试验中达到 93 次成功，而遥操作数据为 84 次，在五个任务中有四个与之持平或超出，仅在堆叠杯子任务上落后一次成功。 在分布外（OOD）条件下，遥操作数据训练的策略降至 46 次成功，而农场数据训练的策略保持 87 次，并在每个任务上都领先。 图 4 (b) 展示了典型的分布外（OOD）试验。

paragraphs.en: The conventional real-to-sim-to-real pipeline, by contrast, transfers poorly. Policies trained on Sim + DR succeed in only 26 of 100 trials in the original scene and 21 in the unseen scene, and they never complete weigh apple. Because Sim + DR shares the grounding, the expert, and the actions with DataFarm and differs only in how observations are produced, the gap of 93 against 26 and 87 against 21 successes isolates the contribution of rendering with real images.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，传统的真实到仿真再到真实的流程迁移效果很差。 在 Sim + DR 上训练的策略在原始场景的 100 次试验中仅成功 26 次，在未见过的场景中仅成功 21 次，并且从未完成称重苹果的任务。 由于 Sim + DR 与 DataFarm 共享相同的场景定位、专家和动作，仅在观测的生成方式上有所不同，因此 93 对 26 以及 87 对 21 的成功次数差距隔离出了使用真实图像进行渲染的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We attribute the robustness of farm-trained policies to the way the farm produces data. Neither training set contains the test tablecloths or the coloured light, but the renderer varies surfaces and lighting around fixed, exact trajectories at no additional cost, so the policy cannot rely on how the table looks; a teleoperated dataset, in contrast, shows only the scene in which it was recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将农场训练策略的鲁棒性归因于农场产生数据的方式。 两个训练集都不包含测试桌布或彩色灯光，但渲染器在无需额外成本的情况下，围绕固定的精确轨迹改变表面和光照，因此策略无法依赖桌子的外观；相比之下，遥操作数据集只展示其录制时所在的场景。

paragraphs.en: The one-time cost of adapting a task depends on the agent. We tested six combinations of four frontier language models and three coding-agent harnesses on three tasks, from the calibration episode to five independently admitted simulated episodes (Figure 5 (b), Table 8 ). All six reach admission, at $12–124 per task on average, and the differences mostly follow token prices. Cost is not the whole comparison, however: the cheapest run needed follow-up instructions on two tasks and admitted episodes that exceed the robot’s joint speed limit (Appendix D ). We report the remaining costs with Claude Opus 5.5 in SoL-Pi [ 30 ] , which needed no human intervention. With these, the one-time cost is $21 of API usage on average over the five tasks, and a render contract adds $5 (Table 3 ). Every further episode needs simulation, rendering, and review, but no robot, operator, or reset.
paragraphs.zh: 适配一个任务的一次性成本取决于智能体。 我们在三个任务上测试了四个前沿语言模型与三个编程智能体框架的六种组合，从校准回合到五个独立准入的模拟回合（图 5 (b)，表 8）。 全部六种组合都达到了准入标准，每个任务平均花费 12–124 美元，差异主要取决于 token 价格。 然而，成本并不是比较的全部：最便宜的一次运行在两个任务上需要后续指令，且其准入的回合超过了机器人的关节速度限制（附录 D）。 我们报告了在 SoL-Pi [30] 中使用 Claude Opus 5.5 的其余成本，该组合无需人工干预。 由此，五个任务的一次性成本平均为 21 美元的 API 用量，而一份渲染合同另需 5 美元（表 3）。 此后的每个回合都需要模拟、渲染和审查，但不再需要机器人、操作员或重置。

paragraphs.en: After adaptation, each admitted episode costs $0.80 on average for rollouts and their audit, rendering on rented GPUs, re-rendering of flagged chunks, and independent review. This cost is the same under new appearance, which is a text change for the farm rather than a restaged scene. paragraphs.en: Action labels remain valid only if the rendered video shows the motion that the simulator executed. We test this by estimating optical flow [ 42 ] on each render and on its untextured simulator video at the same frames (at 512 × \times 288) and comparing the two flow fields on moving pixels, by their mean difference and by the share of pixels on which they agree (Figure 6 ). Averaged over the five tasks, the flow of H3 renders deviates from the simulated flow by 4.4 pixels and agrees on 65% of moving pixels. This is close to Sim + DR, which reproduces the simulated motion exactly and still differs by 3.4 pixels, with 73% agreement, only because the flow estimate depends on appearance. Pairing the same H3 renders with the simulator video half a second later, in contrast, raises the error to 8.8 pixels and lowers agreement to 41%, so the measure clearly separates matched from mismatched motion. Beat drum yields the largest errors for every source, including Sim + DR, because its thin drumsticks move fast; even there, H3 stays much closer to the simulated motion than the shifted control (8.5 against 14.6 pixels).
paragraphs.zh: 只有当渲染出的视频显示智能体模拟器所执行的运动时，动作标签才保持有效。 我们通过以下方式对此进行测试：在每次渲染及其对应的同一帧无纹理模拟器视频（512 × \times 288 分辨率）上估计光流 [42]，并在运动像素上比较两个光流场，依据其平均差异以及两者一致的像素占比（图 6）。 在五个任务上取平均，H3 渲染的光流与模拟光流偏差 4.4 像素，并在 65% 的运动像素上一致。 这接近于 Sim + DR，后者精确复现模拟运动，却仍相差 3.4 像素、一致率 73%，仅仅因为光流估计依赖于外观。 相比之下，将相同的 H3 渲染与半秒后的模拟器视频配对，会把误差提高到 8.8 像素，一致率降至 41%，因此该指标能清晰区分匹配与不匹配的运动。 敲鼓任务对所有来源（包括 Sim + DR）都产生最大误差，因为其细鼓槌移动很快；即便如此，H3 仍比移位对照更接近模拟运动（8.5 像素对 14.6 像素）。

paragraphs.en: Farm episodes look far closer to real recordings than simulator renderings, both visually and in image statistics. Figure 7 shows the same task phase in a real recording, in the simulator, with domain randomization, and in a farm episode. The simulator and its randomized variant reproduce the geometry but not the materials, the lighting, or the robot’s appearance, whereas the farm episode keeps the simulated geometry and takes its appearance from the calibration episode. Image statistics confirm this impression: averaged over the tasks that every source renders, the kernel distance (KID, × 10 3 \times 10^{3} ) of head-view frames to real camera frames is 0.83 for H3 and 0.88 for Seedance, against 1.93 for the simulator and 2.50 with domain randomization, and the farm is closer than the simulator on every task (Appendix E ).

paragraphs.en: Following the simulation in every view is where calling the same video model directly fails. We call MiniMax-H3 with the simulator video as motion reference, real reference frames, and the contract prompt, on one canvas or per camera, and correlate the frame-difference energy and image gradients of each view with the simulator video, on the episodes of stack cups, weigh apple, and pull drawer on which our recipe was developed.

paragraphs.en: Calling the video model directly fails in two ways (Figure 8 and Table 5 ). On one canvas, it reproduces the task state of its reference frames instead of the simulated motion: its motion correlation is 0.07, against 0.74 for the farm’s renderer, and its head view often shows a different task state than a wrist view. Rendered separately, each camera is generated without knowledge of the others, so the wrist views show extra arms, other cup stacks, or the robot from outside. Generating all cameras together is therefore necessary: applied to each camera of stack cups separately, even the farm’s renderer invents cups in the wrist views, and its motion and structure correlations fall from 0.75 and 0.87 to 0.55 and 0.64. Edge control alone makes the render follow the simulator (motion 0.50) but leaves 30 jumps per 1,000 frames, which the references, prompts, and chunk assembly of Section 4.5 reduce to 2.9.
paragraphs.zh: 直接调用视频模型会在两个方面失败（图 8 和表 5）。 在一个画布上，它会复现参考帧中的任务状态而非模拟的运动：其运动相关性为 0.07，而农场渲染器为 0.74，且其头部视角常常显示出与腕部视角不同的任务状态。 由于各相机是分开渲染的，每个相机的生成对其他相机一无所知，因此腕部视角中会出现额外的手臂、其他的杯子堆叠，或从外部看到的机器人。 因此必须将所有相机放在一起生成：即使使用农场的渲染器，若对堆叠杯子的每个相机分别应用，腕部视角中也会凭空出现杯子，其运动相关性和结构相关性会从 0.75 和 0.87 降至 0.55 和 0.64。 仅靠边缘控制可以使渲染跟随模拟器（运动相关性 0.50），但每 1,000 帧仍会有 30 次跳变，而 4.5 节中的参考帧、提示和分块组装方法将其降至 2.9。

paragraphs.en: This realism is also cheap. sents.en: Motion and object states still come from the simulator (Section 6.3 ).

paragraphs.en: DataFarm depends on a simulator that can reproduce the skills of each task. Simulator qualification (Section 4.3 ) detects when the available simulator cannot, but such a task then needs a new simulator variant before the farm can produce data for it. Similarly, a calibration episode cannot identify dynamics that it does not exhibit, such as mass or friction; the farm labels these quantities as assumed and randomizes over them rather than recovering them, which may not suffice for tasks whose success depends on precise dynamics. The verification of generated video is also imperfect: rendered episodes can contain defects that automatic checks miss, which is why every episode undergoes independent review and why rejected renders count toward the cost. Finally, our evaluation covers one dual-arm embodiment and five tasks, and other embodiments and task families remain to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: DataFarm 依赖于一个能够复现每个任务所需技能的模拟器。 模拟器资格认定（第 4.3 节）可以检测出可用模拟器无法胜任的情况，但此时该任务需要一个新的模拟器变体，之后 DataFarm 才能为其生产数据。 类似地，一次标定片段（calibration episode）无法识别其并未表现出的动力学特性，例如质量或摩擦力；DataFarm 会将这些量标记为假定值并对其进行随机化，而不是将其恢复出来，这对于成功与否取决于精确动力学特性的任务而言可能并不充分。 对生成视频的验证也并不完美：渲染出的片段可能包含自动检查无法发现的缺陷，这也是为什么每个片段都要经过独立审查，以及为什么被拒绝的渲染也计入成本。 最后，我们的评估仅涵盖一种双臂本体和五个任务，其他本体和任务类别仍有待测试。

paragraphs.en: Because farm episodes are photographic videos of real scenes, their provenance must remain traceable. Each episode therefore carries a record that binds it to its simulated state, renderer, references, and review, so that a dataset can always be identified as generated. Cheaper data, moreover, does not make deployment safer: a policy trained on farm data still requires real-robot evaluation before use.
paragraphs.zh: 由于农场情景是对真实场景的摄影视频，其来源必须保持可追溯。 因此，每个情景都携带一条记录，将其与其模拟状态、渲染器、参考和审核绑定在一起，从而始终能够识别出某个数据集是生成的。 此外，更便宜的数据并不能使部署更安全：基于农场数据训练的策略在使用前仍需要进行真实机器人评估。

paragraphs.en: We have shown that a coding agent can take the teleoperator’s place in collecting robot data. Given a request and one calibration episode of the scene, the agent compiles the task into a qualified simulation, an expert, and a render contract, and the farm turns this compilation into verified, real-ready episodes at scale, on which policies are trained directly and deployed on the real robot. Correctness does not rest on trusting the agent, because hidden judges, the qualified simulator, and independent reviewers certify what it produces, and every failed attempt is recorded. On the real robot, policies trained only on farm data match policies trained on the same number of teleoperated episodes, hold up far better under appearance that neither training set contained, and far outperform a conventional real-to-sim-to-real pipeline. The farm pays a one-time agent cost of $21 per task on average, $5 for a render contract, and $0.80 for every further episode, without a robot, an operator, or a reset; one hour of three-view data for a task costs $107, these costs included, slightly below a quote of $117 for teleoperation in China and below $290 in labour alone in North America.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经证明，智能体可以取代遥操作者来采集机器人数据。 给定一个请求和该场景的一段校准片段，智能体会将任务编译为合格的仿真环境、一个专家和一个渲染契约，数据工厂再将这一编译结果转化为经过验证、可直接用于真实环境的规模化片段，策略直接在这些片段上训练并部署到真实机器人上。 正确性并不依赖于对智能体的信任，因为隐藏的评判器、合格的仿真器以及独立的审查者会对其产出进行认证，且每一次失败的尝试都会被记录下来。 在真实机器人上，仅用数据工厂数据训练的策略，与用相同数量遥操作片段训练的策略表现相当，在两种训练集均未包含过的外观条件下鲁棒性好得多，并大幅超越传统的 real-to-sim-to-real 流水线。 数据工厂为每个任务支付一次性智能体成本平均 21 美元、渲染契约 5 美元、以及之后每段片段 0.80 美元，且无需机器人、操作员或复位；包含这些成本在内，一个任务的一小时三视角数据花费 107 美元，略低于中国 117 美元的遥操作报价，也低于北美仅人工就需 290 美元的水平。

paragraphs.en: For every attempt, the execution harness checks that the produced document has the stage’s IR type, names its producer, lists exactly its accepted inputs as predecessors, and passes schema validation. It also checks that the receipt binds the stored digest and comes from a verifier whose identity differs from the producer’s. Only a pass with no failed check advances; reject and abstain stay in the history and count against the budget. A rejecting receipt may route the failure to the earliest responsible ancestor. This opens a new epoch that invalidates that stage and its dependents while keeping all prior attempts, and a plan-level reroute budget bounds the number of rewinds. Runs are crash safe: attempts are written ahead, state is re-verified from stored artifacts on resume rather than trusted, and a per-run lock prevents duplicate execution. Paid provider jobs are resumed by their recorded IDs, never resubmitted.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次尝试，执行框架会检查所产出的文档具有该阶段的 IR 类型、注明其生产者、将其已接受的输入精确地列为前驱，并通过模式验证。 它还会检查回执绑定了已存储的摘要，并且来自一个身份与生产者不同的验证者。 只有没有任何检查失败的通过才会向前推进；拒绝与弃权会保留在历史记录中并计入预算。 一份拒绝回执可能会将失败路由到最早负有责任的祖先。 这会开启一个新纪元，使该阶段及其依赖项失效，同时保留所有先前的尝试，并且计划级的重路由预算会限制回退的次数。 运行具备崩溃安全性：尝试会预先写入，恢复时状态会从已存储的工件重新验证而非直接信任，并且每次运行的锁可防止重复执行。 付费的提供商任务通过其记录的 ID 恢复，绝不重新提交。

paragraphs.en: The stages are executed by agents in separate roles (Table 6 ). A context compiler expands each role’s instructions and skills from the pinned capability layer into explicit system and user messages and records the hash of every loaded file and message. Activation therefore does not depend on a host discovering hidden directories, and every session’s instructions can be reproduced. The orchestrator keeps a resumable task state with a phase, next action, open questions, and external job IDs. Its instructions allow it to mark a task needs-input only for intent, device facts, or access that cannot be derived, and the runtime accepts the mark only with concrete open questions. A missing adapter or prompt never qualifies, because generating those is its job. complete is accepted only when the delivery verifier passes, never on the agent’s word.
paragraphs.zh: 各阶段由担任不同角色的智能体执行（表6）。 上下文编译器将每个角色的指令和技能从锁定的能力层展开为明确的系统消息和用户消息，并记录每个已加载文件和消息的哈希值。 因此，激活不依赖于宿主发现隐藏目录，且每个会话的指令都可以复现。 编排器维护可恢复的任务状态，包括阶段、下一步操作、待解答问题以及外部作业 ID。 其指令规定，只有当意图、设备事实或访问权限无法推导出来时，它才能将任务标记为 needs-input，且运行时只有在提供了具体的待解答问题时才接受该标记。 缺失适配器或提示词永远不构成理由，因为生成它们本来就是它的工作。只有交付验证器通过时才接受 complete，绝不因智能体的单方面声明而接受。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists the agent roles, what each produces, and what each is not allowed to do.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 列出了智能体角色、每个角色产出的内容，以及每个角色不允许做的事情。

paragraphs.en: Each fact in a delivered episode has exactly one source that may certify it (Table 7 ). The real episode is authoritative only for what it shows or measures, so physical parameters that it does not determine remain labelled as fitted, assumed, or unknown, together with their uncertainty. The simulator becomes authoritative for actions and states only after it has been qualified for the skills of the task, whereas the renderer may change only the appearance that the data mode permits, and a real reference image supplies appearance but never positions, layout, motion, or additional objects. Verifiers and reviewers, finally, may admit or reject an episode but cannot modify it. Because no agent role or program both proposes and certifies the same fact, an error made by one component must be caught by another before it reaches the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 已交付回合（episode）中的每个事实都恰好有一个可以为其作证的来源（表 7）。 真实回合仅对其所展示或测量的内容具有权威性，因此它未能确定的物理参数仍被标记为拟合、假设或未知，并附带其不确定性。 模拟器只有在针对任务的技能完成鉴定之后，才能对动作和状态具有权威性；而渲染器只能改变数据模式所允许的外观，真实参考图像仅提供外观信息，绝不提供位置、布局、运动或额外物体。 最后，验证者和审查者可以接受或拒绝一个回合，但不能修改它。 由于没有任何智能体角色或程序会同时提出并认证同一事实，某一组件所犯的错误必须在进入数据集之前被另一个组件捕获。

paragraphs.en: For the farm, we render at 640 × \times 480 with our H3 deployment, which takes 37–53 s per 192-frame chunk on one B200 at $3 per GPU-hour, near the lowest published B200 rental quote ($2.80 per GPU-hour, October 2026), plus 20% for worker start-up, recompiles, and failed jobs as observed in our runs. In these runs, every chunk was screened by a vision-language model and re-rendered if flagged (1.1–1.8 renders per chunk; Section 4.5 ), and every episode is reviewed with Claude Haiku 5.5. The farm’s one-time and contract costs are the corresponding rows of Table 3 . Its marginal cost m m per admitted episode divides the rendering, screening, and review cost of an attempt by the admission rate and adds the rollouts and audit of Table 3 per simulated episode, measured on 100 episodes and assumed to scale linearly; a rejected render is attempted again from the same simulated episode, so this term is not divided by the admission rate. paragraphs.en: Large teleoperated datasets have driven the recent progress of vision-language-action models, which shows the value of diverse physical experience [ 25 , 2 , 3 , 12 , 58 , 32 , 15 ] . Subsequent work lowers the cost of collection, either with hand-held interfaces that record demonstrations without a robot [ 9 ] or with foundation-model orchestrators that propose tasks and coordinate fleets of robots [ 1 ] . Each episode, however, still requires a person, a device, and a physical scene, so the cost grows with the number of episodes and starts over for every new task. DataFarm instead requires a single calibration episode of the scene and produces every episode of the dataset without robot or operator time.

paragraphs.en: Language models are increasingly used to automate the construction of robot learning tasks. They write policies as code [ 28 , 40 ] , design rewards [ 33 ] , and generate tasks together with their simulation supervision [ 46 , 47 ] , and RoboTwin 2.0 closes a code-repair loop between a multimodal model and the simulator to generate bimanual data at scale [ 6 ] . These tasks, however, are specified by text and asset libraries rather than by a real scene, their observations are simulator renderings, and the model that writes a task often also writes the check that grades it. In DataFarm , the agent grounds the task in a recording of the real scene and writes the expert against a judge it cannot see, while independent reviewers decide which episodes are admitted and the appearance comes from the real scene.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型正被越来越多地用于自动化构建机器人学习任务。 它们将策略写成代码 [ 28 , 40 ]，设计奖励 [ 33]，连同其仿真监督一起生成任务 [ 46 , 47]，而 RoboTwin 2.0 在多模态模型与仿真器之间构建了一个代码修复闭环，以大规模生成双手操作数据 [ 6 ]。 然而，这些任务是由文本和资产库而非真实场景指定的，其观测来自仿真器渲染，而且编写任务的模型往往也编写了为该任务评分的检查。 在 DataFarm 中，智能体将任务锚定在真实场景的录制上，并针对一个它看不见的裁判来编写专家策略，同时由独立的评审者决定哪些回合被采纳，且外观来源于真实场景。

paragraphs.en: Real-to-sim-to-real methods narrow the visual gap by reconstructing the target scene in simulation. RialTo trains policies in reconstructed digital twins [ 44 ] , URDFormer predicts articulated simulation models from images [ 8 ] , and digital-cousin systems trade exact replicas for diverse, affordance-preserving scenes [ 10 , 38 ] . Gaussian splatting further makes reconstructed scenes photorealistic: SplatSim replaces meshes with splats inside a physics simulator [ 37 ] , RoboGSim and Re 3 Sim combine reconstruction with a physics engine to synthesize demonstrations [ 26 , 16 ] , Real2Render2Real renders object scans along trajectories retargeted from a human video [ 52 ] , and Video2Sim2Real refines object-centric anchors from video in simulation [ 17 ] . In all of these pipelines, however, appearance is only as good as the reconstructed assets: every object and scene must be scanned or modelled, deformable objects and state-dependent appearance such as cloth or a lit display remain hard to represent, and a change of scene requires a new capture. DataFarm keeps the simulator for actions and states but takes appearance from a video model conditioned on real images, so it needs no per-object scan, renders cloth and displays as they look, and changes surfaces or lighting through text.
paragraphs.zh: Real-to-sim-to-real 方法通过在仿真中重建目标场景来缩小视觉差距。 RialTo 在重建的数字孪生中训练策略 [ 44 ]，URDFormer 从图像预测带关节的仿真模型 [ 8]，而数字近亲系统用多样且保留可供性的场景替代精确复制品 [ 10 , 38 ]。 高斯泼溅进一步使重建场景具有照片级真实感：SplatSim 在物理仿真器内用泼溅替代网格 [ 37 ]，RoboGSim 和 Re 3 Sim 将重建与物理引擎结合以合成演示 [ 26 , 16 ]，Real2Render2Real 沿从人类视频重定向的轨迹渲染物体扫描 [ 52 ]，Video2Sim2Real 在仿真中从视频精炼以物体为中心的锚点 [ 17 ]。 然而，在所有这些流程中，外观的效果仅取决于重建资产的质量：每个物体和场景都必须被扫描或建模，可变形物体以及依赖状态的外观（如布料或点亮的显示屏）仍难以表示，且场景的任何变化都需要重新采集。 DataFarm 保留仿真器用于动作和状态，但外观取自以真实图像为条件的视频模型，因此它无需逐物体扫描，能按布料和显示屏的真实样子进行渲染，并可通过文本改变表面或光照。

paragraphs.en: Generative models offer another route to realistic observations [ 57 , 21 , 5 , 29 ] . Image-level augmentation inpaints new objects and backgrounds into robot data [ 53 , 7 , 54 ] , but it edits frames independently and cannot add new motion. Video models lift this restriction in different ways: DreamGen generates new robot videos and recovers pseudo-actions with an inverse-dynamics or latent-action model [ 22 ] , Cosmos-Transfer and RoboTransfer generate video under structural controls such as edges and depth [ 35 , 31 ] , and EmbodieDreamer and CRAFT turn simulator renderings into realistic video while the simulator supplies the actions [ 45 , 4 ] . Robot-video benchmarks nevertheless show that structure, physics, task adherence, and action completion fail independently in such videos [ 11 ] , so realism alone does not make the data usable. DataFarm shares the idea of rendering simulated trajectories and adds three components: an agent that builds the simulation task from one calibration episode, conditioning on that episode’s own images so that the output matches the deployment scene, and independent admission of every long multi-view episode against its simulated state.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型为实现逼真的观测提供了另一条途径 [57, 21, 5, 29]。 图像级增强将新物体和背景修补进机器人数据中 [53, 7, 54]，但它对帧进行独立编辑，无法添加新的运动。 视频模型以不同方式突破了这一限制：DreamGen 生成新的机器人视频，并通过逆动力学模型或潜在动作模型恢复伪动作 [22]；Cosmos-Transfer 和 RoboTransfer 在边缘、深度等结构化控制条件下生成视频 [35, 31]；EmbodieDreamer 和 CRAFT 将仿真器渲染结果转化为逼真视频，同时由仿真器提供动作 [45, 4]。 然而，机器人视频基准测试表明，此类视频在结构、物理、任务遵循和动作完成度上会各自独立地出现问题 [11]，因此仅有逼真性并不能使数据可用。 DataFarm 沿用了渲染仿真轨迹这一思路，并增加了三个组件：一个智能体，它根据一次标定的回合构建仿真任务，并以该回合自身的图像为条件，使输出与部署场景相匹配；以及对每个长的多视角回合基于其仿真状态进行独立准入判定。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents have become capable of sustained software engineering [ 48 ] . With suitable tool interfaces they resolve real repository issues [ 50 ] , and self-improving agent systems retain program versions that score better on external benchmarks [ 55 , 19 , 56 ] . Language models nevertheless remain unreliable judges of their own output [ 20 ] . DataFarm therefore uses such an agent as the task compiler of a data farm but separates its work from the certification of that work.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体已经能够完成持续的软件工程工作 [ 48 ] 。 通过合适的工具接口，它们能够解决真实的代码仓库问题 [ 50 ] ，而自我改进的智能体系统会保留在外部基准测试中得分更高的程序版本 [ 55 , 19 , 56 ] 。 然而，语言模型在评判自身输出方面仍然不可靠 [ 20 ] 。 因此，DataFarm 将这样一个智能体用作数据工厂的任务编译器，但将其工作与对该工作的认证分离开来。
